$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: A receipt
description: What happened to a message on the host it went to.

mid.description: The message's id across the network (its envelope's mid)

agent.description: The recipient, unqualified: xenonet:start for a start request

state.description: stored: the receiving engine has it (the sender may drop it from its outbox); held: it waits because the session bypasses permission checks. For a start request: started, refused, then ended

session.description: For started and ended: the new session's id (null for Codex until it names its thread)

folder.description: For started: its folder, with the home folder as ~

exit.description: For ended: its exit code, null when it was stopped

minutes.description: For ended: how long it ran

signIn.description: For ended: Claude Code there needs a sign-in for XenoNet's runs
